questions.q: Is it possible to use exactly 500 matchsticks in such a row? Show your working.

points: No, n must be a natural number
pointsAf: Nee, n moet ’n natuurlike getal wees

sections.title: Finance and growth

questions.q: Ayanda invests R15 000 at 9% p.a. simple interest for 4 years. Calculate the value of the investment after 4 years.
questions.qAf: Ayanda belê R15 000 teen 9% p.j. enkelvoudige rente vir 4 jaar. Bereken die waarde van die belegging ná 4 jaar.

questions.q: Pieter invests R15 000 at 8% p.a. interest compounded annually for 4 years. Calculate the value of his investment after 4 years.
questions.qAf: Pieter belê R15 000 teen 8% p.j. rente, jaarliks saamgestel, vir 4 jaar. Bereken die waarde van sy belegging ná 4 jaar.

questions.q: Whose investment is worth more after 4 years, and by how much?
questions.qAf: Wie se belegging is ná 4 jaar meer werd, en met hoeveel?

questions.q: A fridge costs R12 000 today. Calculate what it will cost in 3 years’ time if the inflation rate is 6,5% p.a.
questions.qAf: ’n Yskas kos vandag R12 000. Bereken wat dit oor 3 jaar sal kos as die inflasiekoers 6,5% p.j. is.

questions.q: A cellphone costs R9 000. It is bought on hire purchase with a 15% deposit, and the balance is paid off over 2 years at 18% p.a. simple interest. Calculate the monthly instalment.
questions.qAf: ’n Selfoon kos R9 000. Dit word op huurkoop gekoop met ’n deposito van 15%, en die balans word oor 2 jaar teen 18% p.j. enkelvoudige rente afbetaal. Bereken die maandelikse paaiement.

sections.intro: Give money answers correct to the nearest cent.
sections.introAf: Gee geldbedrae korrek tot die naaste sent.

questions.scenario: A learner is chosen at random. Calculate the probability that the learner:
questions.scenarioAf: ’n Leerder word ewekansig gekies. Bereken die waarskynlikheid dat die leerder:

questions.q: owns a cellphone but not a tablet
questions.qAf: ’n selfoon maar nie ’n tablet besit nie

questions.q: owns neither
questions.qAf: nie een van die twee besit nie

questions.q: owns a cellphone or a tablet
questions.qAf: ’n selfoon of ’n tablet besit

questions.q: Are the events M and T mutually exclusive? Give a reason.
questions.qAf: Is die gebeurtenisse M en T onderling uitsluitend? Gee ’n rede.

questions.q: A fair coin is tossed 50 times and lands heads 29 times. Compare the relative frequency of heads with the theoretical probability of heads.
questions.qAf: ’n Regverdige muntstuk word 50 keer opgegooi en land 29 keer op kop. Vergelyk die relatiewe frekwensie van kop met die teoretiese waarskynlikheid van kop.
points: theoretical probability = 0,5; with many more tosses the relative frequency gets closer to 0,5
pointsAf: teoretiese waarskynlikheid = 0,5; met baie meer gooie kom die relatiewe frekwensie nader aan 0,5

sections.intro: In a group of 150 learners, 90 own a cellphone (M), 60 own a tablet (T) and 35 own both.
